name: particles
title: Particles
description: A canvas of drifting particles that are gently attracted to the pointer, for backgrounds with some depth.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. The canvas fills it and follows its size.

props.name: staticity
props.description: How strongly particles resist the pointer; lower values follow it more.

props.name: ease
props.description: Smoothing of the pointer attraction; higher values react more slowly.

props.name: size
props.description: Base particle radius in pixels (each particle adds a random 0–1px).

props.name: color
props.description: Particle colour as a hex string. Changes apply live.

props.name: vx
props.description: Constant horizontal drift in pixels per frame.

props.name: vy
props.description: Constant vertical drift in pixels per frame.
